components.name: Gold Button
components.description: The one primary action per view on dark grounds.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-gold { background: #C9A23A; color: #0E0B12; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #DDB94F; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Export actions on the ivory reading sheet, with an 18px leading outline icon.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: #0E0B12; color: #FAF6EA; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #3B2A86; } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3B2A86; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions over photos and dark empty states.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.45); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(14, 11, 18, 0.25); color: #FAF6EA; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.1); border-color: #FAF6EA; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel Input
components.description: Text field on the violet indigo panel, with a tracked-caps label and mono hint.
components.html: Press Enter after each one.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #24185A; padding: 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.72); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(14, 11, 18, 0.35); border: 1px solid rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.22); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Merriweather', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; color: #FAF6EA; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.6); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C9A23A; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #C9A23A; } .ds-hint { margin: 0; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.6); }

components.name: Ingredient Chip
components.description: Ivory chip for each pantry ingredient, with a circular remove target.
components.html: garlic
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 12px; background: #FAF6EA; color: #24185A; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; } .ds-chip-x { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: #3B2A86; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-x:hover { background: #F1EBD9; } .ds-chip-x:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Leave-out Toggle
components.description: Pill checkbox for intolerances; checked fills gold and strikes the word through.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle span { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.3); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.72); transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-toggle:hover span { border-color: #FAF6EA; color: #FAF6EA; } .ds-toggle input:checked + span { background: #C9A23A; border-color: #C9A23A; color: #0E0B12; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-topbar { height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: #0E0B12; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.16); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; color: #FAF6EA; } .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 28px; height: 100%; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; padding-top: 2px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.72); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #FAF6EA; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: #FAF6EA; border-bottom-color: #C9A23A; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Rail Button
components.description: Gold outline icon in a circle with a tracked-caps label; stacks on the right edge of each dish.
components.css: .ds-rail-btn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 64px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: #FAF6EA; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail-icon { box-sizing: content-box; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(201, 162, 58, 0.7); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(14, 11, 18, 0.45); color: #C9A23A; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-rail-btn:hover .ds-rail-icon { background: #C9A23A; color: #0E0B12; } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Up Next Queue Item
components.description: Ranked row with mono number, Jost name, and mono have/need meta; the active row fills indigo.
components.css: .ds-queue-item { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr; gap: 2px 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.16); background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-queue-item:hover { background: rgba(59, 42, 134, 0.3); } .ds-queue-item.is-active { background: #24185A; } .ds-queue-n { grid-row: span 2; padding-top: 3px; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-queue-name { font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.92); } .ds-queue-item.is-active .ds-queue-name { color: #C9A23A; } .ds-queue-meta { font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(250, 246, 234, 0.6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-queue-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A23A; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Reading Checklist Row
components.description: Ingredient row on the ivory sheet; done rows strike through in gold.
components.css: .ds-checklist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 16px; background: #FAF6EA; } .ds-checklist li { border-top: 1px solid #DDD4BF; border-bottom: 1px solid #DDD4BF; } .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 11px 0; cursor: pointer; position: relative; font-family: 'Merriweather', Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.75; color: #0E0B12; } .ds-check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-check-box { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-top: 4px; border: 1.5px solid #3B2A86; border-radius: 3px; color: transparent; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-check input:checked + .ds-check-box { background: #3B2A86; color: #FAF6EA; } .ds-check input:checked ~ .ds-check-text { color: #4E4858; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: #C9A23A; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-check input:focus-visible + .ds-check-box { outline: 2px solid #3B2A86; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Adca is a dark stage with one lit plate on it. Rich Black is the room, violet indigo is the furniture (the pantry panel, the active queue row, the mobile bar), and the food photograph is the only thing in full colour: it fills its frame edge to edge under a black scrim that rises from the bottom so the Jost title, a gold Geist Mono readout, and a Merriweather caption can sit on it. Glamour Gold is the house light that picks out what you can act on: focus rings, the outline icon rail, the active tab underline, the primary action, the match readout.

When the visitor commits to a dish, the room changes. The recipe page splits into a sticky black photo stage on the left and an Ivory White reading sheet on the right, where the accent switches from gold to violet indigo and Merriweather sets the method at 17px with generous leading. The dark world is for choosing; the ivory sheet is for cooking.

Density is moderate and deliberate: tracked uppercase Jost on every control, hairline rules instead of boxes, mono numerals for every count. Nothing is a card. Results are a vertical scroll-snap feed of full-height dishes, never a thumbnail grid.
keyCharacteristics: Rich Black ground, violet indigo panels, full-bleed photography under a bottom-weighted black scrim.
Glamour Gold as the single accent on dark grounds; violet indigo as the accent on ivory.
Jost for titles and tracked-caps controls, Merriweather for anything read as prose, Geist Mono for counts, readouts, and hints.
Hairline rules (1px) and 4px corners; pills only for toggles and the position counter; circles only for icon buttons.
One outline icon set: 24px grid, 1.5px stroke, round caps and joins.
Motion is short colour fades (0.2s) plus a long expo-out ease for reveals and the mobile sheet.

rules.name: The Accent Follows the Ground Rule
rules.body: Gold is the accent on black and indigo; Bright Violet Indigo is the accent on ivory. Gold is never text on ivory.

rules.name: The Photograph Is the Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface stays within black, indigo, gold, and ivory so the dish photo is the only full-spectrum element on screen.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Jost names things and labels actions, Merriweather speaks in sentences, Geist Mono counts. Do not set a sentence in Jost or a number readout in Merriweather.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Every button and tab is uppercase Jost at 0.14em tracking (0.1em at the small size). The text-link button is the only exception: sentence case, underlined.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element sits above another layer (dropdown, sheet). Resting surfaces never carry one.

dos: Do use Glamour Gold for the one primary action per view, for focus, and for readouts on dark grounds; switch to Bright Violet Indigo for the same jobs on the ivory sheet.
Do set every count and numeral in Geist Mono with tabular figures, zero-padded where it ranks (01, 02).
Do put text on photography only over the bottom scrim, and back any control on a photo with a translucent black fill.
Do keep controls at least 44px tall (48px for primary buttons) and give every interactive element the 2px focus outline.
Do use 1px hairlines (`line-dark` on dark, `line-light` on ivory) to separate rows instead of boxing them.
Do honour reduced motion: smooth scroll and transitions switch off and slide text shows at full opacity.
donts: Don't present results as a grid of thumbnail cards; one dish fills the frame at a time.
Don't set gold text on the ivory sheet; gold appears there only as the strike-through line.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces; reserve them for the dropdown and the mobile sheet.
Don't introduce a second icon style, filled icons, or emoji and text glyphs as icons; extend the 24px, 1.5px-stroke outline set.
Don't round controls beyond 4px; pills belong to toggles and the position counter, circles to icon buttons.
Don't set prose in Jost or readouts in Merriweather.
